compatibility.notes: The capability describes behavior and evidence; harness-specific test commands remain repository context.

do_not_use_when.text: The intended behavior cannot be expressed through any stable seam
The request is to investigate or repair existing behavior rather than build new behavior

use_when.text: A behavior slice can be exercised through a meaningful public seam that the test will survive refactors through
The repository exposes deterministic feedback suitable for red-green iteration

evidence_outputs.description: Implemented behavior plus the test that proves it.
evidence_outputs.name: behavior_slice_result

evidence_outputs.description: Targeted and required repository verification outcomes.
evidence_outputs.name: verification_result

inputs.description: One observable behavior to implement through a stable public seam.
inputs.name: behavior_slice

inputs.description: Repository and verification conventions governing the implementation.
inputs.name: repository_scope

outputs.description: Smallest coherent implementation satisfying the declared behavior slice.
outputs.name: implemented_behavior

outputs.description: Refactor-resistant test proving the behavior through the agreed seam.
outputs.name: behavioral_test

preconditions.description: A meaningful interface exists where the intended behavior can be exercised and observed.

capability.purpose: Build externally meaningful behavior through seam-aware red-green vertical slices and deterministic feedback.

requirements.description: The behavioral test fails for the intended missing or broken behavior before implementation.
The same behavioral test passes after the smallest correct implementation.
Required repository verification is run before completion.
